objective: No previously rejected human visual family may be silently selected as final hero/dialogue/NPC. Motion components can be independently evaluated and carried to a different mesh/rig.

reasons: Human faces and torsos made from spheres/boxes/cylinders
Looks like a generic toy or placeholder, not production character
entries.scope: Specific visual implementation; does not ban primitive geometry for props/architecture.

reasons: Demonstration figure's fixed blue/green/white appearance and face are visually unacceptable as final characters
Simple recolor, cap or accessories are not new visual identity
entries.scope: Reject current CesiumMan VISUAL only; not all CC BY glTF assets, not the library's animation principles.

reasons: Same underlying morphology recolored for two dialogue characters
First-person face and expression quality insufficient
entries.scope: Reject these specific assets/closeup use, not Quaternius entire library or neutral secondary roles.

reasons: Hand-lofted custom mesh avoids classic primitives but still fails visual anatomical expectations
Face/eyes/skin and detailed rig inadequate at target shot distance
entries.scope: Ban THIS constructed face as approved model; not all authored Blender mesh techniques.

reasons: Proxy/placeholder cannot be claimed as a finished character or increase art readiness
entries.scope: Permitted for internal prototype only; if no replacement can be produced, still deliver best full-scene candidate with honest character FAIL, never declare artistic approval.

candidateMotionComponents.component: CesiumMan walk clip and path control
candidateMotionComponents.requires: Extract motion source+rig map, prove retarget compatibility and foot contact before integrating into different model

selectionRule: A negative visual cannot become approved by changing color alone. New source must differ materially in topology/silhouette/face/UV/authoring; acquisition alternatives compared with evidence, no fake pass. If technically impossible, full scene is still delivered with visual character FAIL and explicit workaround.
promotionRule: Only user-approved appearance based on actual viewed frames, rights-compatible source, loadable editable asset, valid skeleton/animation (if required), second scene reuse proof can elevate to approved visual family. Do not promote merely by deterministic tests.
